name: hs_outcome_canceled_count
label: Outcome canceled count
description: 1 if outcome is canceled otherwise 0
calculationFormula: if (is_present(string(hs_meeting_outcome)) and string(hs_meeting_outcome) equals 'CANCELED') then 1 else 0

name: hs_outcome_completed_count
label: Outcome completed count
description: 1 if outcome is completed otherwise 0
calculationFormula: if (is_present(string(hs_meeting_outcome)) and string(hs_meeting_outcome) equals 'COMPLETED') then 1 else 0

name: hs_outcome_no_show_count
label: Outcome no show count
description: 1 if outcome is no-show otherwise 0
calculationFormula: if (is_present(string(hs_meeting_outcome)) and string(hs_meeting_outcome) equals 'NO_SHOW') then 1 else 0

name: hs_outcome_rescheduled_count
label: Outcome rescheduled count
description: 1 if outcome is rescheduled otherwise 0
calculationFormula: if (is_present(string(hs_meeting_outcome)) and string(hs_meeting_outcome) equals 'RESCHEDULED') then 1 else 0

name: hs_outcome_scheduled_count
label: Outcome scheduled count
description: 1 if outcome is scheduled otherwise 0
calculationFormula: if (is_present(string(hs_meeting_outcome)) and string(hs_meeting_outcome) equals 'SCHEDULED') then 1 else 0

name: hs_time_to_book_meeting_from_first_contact
